title: Water contamination in the Foo River basin
subtitle: Evidence edition, 2022–2026
topic: water contamination and its health effects in the Foo River basin
question: What do open sources document about contamination events in the Foo River basin between 1 January 2022 and 30 June 2026?

grades.A: Two or more independent credible sources, or a documented investigation by a regulator or major NGO.
grades.B: One credible non-partisan source, or a credible local source corroborated by other evidence.
grades.C: A single local, partisan or unverified source. Recorded because it may assist further work, not because it is established.
